result:
1. Commit numeric HALT thresholds before spend — never "reassess if it looks bad."
2. Include a same-input churn arm with a numeric floor whenever scoring per-item presence/absence across LLM redraws; treat "effect is inside the churn floor" as a first-class outcome, and flag n=1 drift runs as anti-conservative (n=2 gives a floor, not an estimate).
3. Make outcome tables total and ensure rows partition the full outcome space (check total, two-sided, n-consistent, non-degenerate at this n).
4. Explicitly write NULL-composite rows for every arm that can read NULL.
5. Apply two-sided calibration to every gate: verify it fires on a planted violation AND stays quiet on the clean case.
6. Pre-register selection rules for controls, including the RNG seed, before the arm they select on runs, plus an explicit skip-as-moot branch.
7. Classify the cause of each kill-condition failure when more than one cause with different correct responses exists, and write that classification step into the prereg.
8. Pin an effect-size floor (magnitude/share above uniform expectation) before computing any grid value, not just an α threshold; report the small stratum's MDE alongside it, and treat failure to clear the floor as "not a falsifier" rather than a negative result.
9. Report a failed locked metric as failed, full stop — do not retrofit a passing metric; instead ask a new pre-registered question keyed on a quantity unobserved at lock time.
10. Surface recon gates interactively to the operator at fire time, with witness and pre-committed branch, not post-hoc in the writeup.
11. Make freeze ordering witnessable: write PREREGISTRATION.md → md5sum it into audit_log.md above the first result → run; show both md5s with positions on amendment.
12. Split tolerance by indicator kind (consumer safety vs. process quality) and by whether firing is systemic or idiosyncratic, rather than using one aggregate tolerance.
13. Ensure churn/discount rules cover every payload-carrying file, not just one file standing in for all.

COUNT=13
